title: Classic Hearty Chili
ingredients: 1 15 oz can light red kidney beans, drained and rinsed
instructions: In a large pot over medium-high heat, cook ground beef with onion, bell pepper, and celery until beef is browned and vegetables are tender (8–10 minutes). Drain excess fat.
Return mixture to the pot. Add tomato juice, tomato sauce, diced tomatoes, rinsed kidney beans, and all seasonings.
Stir well and bring to a rolling boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered for 2 to 3 hours, stirring occasionally until rich and thick.
Turkey/Chicken Variation: Brown separately with tomato paste and soy sauce, then add 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce to the chili pot.
Lamb Variation: Add 1.5 tbsp each coriander, cumin, smoked paprika during meat browning and 1/4 tsp cinnamon before simmering.
Pork Shoulder Variation: Cut into 1/2-inch cubes, sear hard, then proceed with the recipe.
